status: source-stage protocol; target BO integration is a later separately frozen stage
scope: small neural representation versus task-PCA on HPO-B-derived source tasks

entry_gate.required: parent RESULTS.neural_entry_gate == true and parent VERIFICATION.passed == true
before_gate_forbidden: neural fitting on real source labels

source_scope.reuse: exact same source rows as parent; no additional source/target labels
source_scope.normalization: context sample mean and SD only, SD<1e-8 replaced with 1

source_holdout.unit: raw dataset group globally across all spaces
source_holdout.rule: greedy cover all 15 spaces, ties by SHA256(hpob_neural_source_valid_v1|group), then fill by hash; preserve >=3 train groups and >=1 validation group per space
source_holdout.failure: stop if coverage cannot be satisfied; never rearrange using y or outcomes

probability_model.conditioning: one joint Gaussian conditioning operation; no double use of context likelihood
probability_model.base: unit-amplitude ARD Matern 5/2; positive lengthscales>=0.025 and noise>=0.0001
probability_model.uncertainty_limit: conditional Gaussian uncertainty given fitted parameters, not a full Bayesian posterior over network weights

pca.reference: up to 2048 unique pooled training-source X, input-only deterministic permutation
pca.source_models: parent source GPs from source-training groups only; no held-out-group GP
pca.low_rank: pad zero when source task rank<8; disclose effective rank
pca.covariance_calibration: fit base hyperparameters using the same source episodes and validation rule

planned_training.context_distribution: half uniform, half paid-only online-search prefixes generated exclusively inside source-training tasks
planned_training.task_sampling: uniform tasks within each space, with replacement; episodes are not independent tasks
planned_training.loss: joint conditional predictive NLL per query, averaged equally over task episodes
planned_training.checkpoint: minimum source-validation NLL; full trajectory and calibration/ranking metrics retained
planned_training.training_protocol_note: episode manifest/search-state generator and training source hashes must be frozen before fitting

later_controls: same neural mean with PCA covariance

target_stage.requirements: retain O/P/A/R references; freeze rollout and statistical contrasts separately; do not infer closed-loop value from NLL alone
